messages:
Leah D: Heads-up — field sprint request from Acme: they need a low-downtime upgrade path + egress IP preservation for private deploys. Asking if we can move this into next sprint. Need cost/effort estimate.
Mia C: Thanks. Do we have scoped requirements? e.g., keep same egress IPs across installer upgrades, or only during major version? @NetOps Joe?
NetOps Joe: For Acme they want static egress IPs for their firewall rules — doable via NAT EIP pooling but OS-level changes during upgrade can change outbound source. We can preserve by keeping the relay/egress proxy pinned; that adds ~1 VM/service to manage per customer.
Ankur R: Tradeoff: added managed egress node means extra infra and SLA. Also affects onprem airgap customers. We should scope: (1) preserve egress IPs for patch/minor upgrades only, (2) support optional managed relay for major upgrades. Estimate: ~3 sprints to implement + testing.
Devon: Alternative is clearly documented upgrade windows + post-upgrade IP update script + scheduled maintenance. Lower effort but requires customer firewall windows. Probably acceptable for ~80% customers.
Leah D: For prioritization we need launch criteria. Proposed: must support near-zero downtime for patch upgrades, documented rollback, and an opt-in 'pinned-egress' feature. Thoughts?
Mia C: Can we add a compatibility check in the installer that warns when egress IPs will change? small UX win.
NetOps Joe: yes — installer can snapshot NAT config and display. also we can include operator flag `--preserve-egress` to opt in.
Devon: Rollout plan suggestion: canary with 3 customers (one internal, one ACME-like, one air-gapped) over 2 weeks. Success metrics: upgrade failure rate <1%, median downtime <2 minutes.
Leah D: ok. @deploy-bot please create ticket and schedule spike for effort estimate.
deploy-bot: created TICKET-4217: 'pinned-egress feature spike' assigned to Ankur R, due in 2w.
Ankur R: assigning to myself. Will scope ACME acceptance tests, quantify infra cost, and draft runbook.
Mia C: adding eval prompts + customer-facing doc stub at /docs/private-deploy/egress-preservation.md.
Leah D: thanks. moving to 'needs estimation'. :thumbsup:
NetOps Joe: quick operator config snippet for the relay option:
```
operator:
  preserve_egress: true
  egress_pool: acme-pool-1
```
Mia C: I'll follow up with UX microcopy for installer warnings.
Leah D: let's sync tomorrow 9am PT. Anyone can't make it?
Ankur R: I'm good.
Devon: on PTO — can catch up after. :wave:
NetOps Joe: I'll be there.
Leah D: great, closing thread.
